name: Seraphine
notes: The opening cast is Encore (R): Echo (Stage Presence) starts at its maximum of 2 stacks at the start of the game, so this very first ability cast immediately consumes them, granting a free extra cast of Encore about 1.01 seconds later.

Encore's damage lands 0.5 seconds after the cast starts (it fires from Seraphine's location at the end of the first cast time); the further 0.5 second phase is a pure lockout on Seraphine, so attacks are held for a full 1.0 second around every Encore cast, and an Echoed Encore is modeled the same way, starting after a further 0.01 second delay.

High Note and Beat Drop are cast on cooldown; their damage is applied at the moment of the cast, matching the usual 0.25 second cast-time lockout (the extra missile travel time described on the wiki is not modeled, as with Jax's dashes), and an Echoed cast of either resolves 0.25s + 0.01s later the same way.

Echo stacks up to 2 on any basic ability cast; once at 2 stacks the next cast is doubled for free and stacks reset to 0. The doubled cast does not add a new Echo stack itself, is not cheaper and does not touch the mimicked ability's cooldown, but it is treated as its own separate damage instance (High Note's missing-health amplifier is recalculated against the dummy's health at that later moment).

Harmony grants a Note to Seraphine on every ability cast, including Echoed casts, stacking up to 4 and refreshing a shared 6 second timer. Whenever at least one Note is active, Seraphine's next basic attack fires all of them at the target as separate magic damage instances in addition to the attack's own damage, then the stack is spent.

Note damage is assumed not to critically strike: only the wiki's own basic attack is stated to critically strike, not each Note instance, so Note damage is treated as ordinary (non-crit) on-hit magic damage.
Surround Sound (W) is never cast: it deals no direct damage, so the cast slot is spent on Q/E/R and attacks instead, which do more damage; it is only included here for completeness.
Beat Drop's 70% damage reduction against minions does not apply because the stat dummy counts as a champion.
The 75% damage reduction for Notes that originated from an ally does not apply: with no allies present every Note is Seraphine's own, at full value.
Mana costs are not modeled: at level 16 Seraphine's mana pool comfortably covers the handful of Q/E/R casts made within a fight of this length.

assumed.why: the wiki states Encore's second 0.5s phase is 'a lockout' for Seraphine after the wave fires; assumed this also holds her basic attacks (not just further casts), so the model holds attacks for a full 1.0s (both phases) around each Encore cast.
